searchText: Hi <@543900561460822016> I was looking at the Pr https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/26621 and it mentions checksums for each file. However to my understanding the snappy framing format is not deterministic, so this would be an issue cross client implementations. Is the intention just to provide an integrity check of the file, or is my understanding of snappy framing incorrect? interesting, i was not aware of this hm how does this work on p2p then? that is also snappy compressed yet we are able to interoperate across all clients?
